content: Awař n SIDI yusa-dd ɣar Yunus, mmis n Amittay, inna:
“Kkar, ruḥ ɣar tendint n Ninwa tameqqrant uca barreḥ ḍidd nnes minzi tuɛeffna nsen tgeɛɛed am ict n arriḥet yarṣuden ař udem inu.”

Maca Yunus ikkar ḥima ad yarweř zeg wudem n SIDI. Netta ihwa ɣar tendint n Yafa uca yufa din ict n tɣarrabut ad traḥ ɣar tendint n Tarcic. Netta ixeǧeṣ ttaman n usafar uca inya dayes maḥend ad iraḥ ɣar Tarcic, ixs ad iggʷej x wudem n SIDI.
Maca SIDI issekk-dd asemmiḍ ijhed x řebḥar uca yarni idweř d taḥaryaḍt tameqqrant x řebḥar ařami ɛřaḥař tiweḍ ad tarẓ tɣarrabut.

Ggʷeden ibeḥriyyen uca kuř aryaz isɣuy, ittar ɣar arebbi nnes uca nḍaren řeqcuɛ nni di tɣarrabut ɣar řebḥar ḥima ad xas ssneqṣen ddqeř. Tuɣa ihwa-dd Yunus maca ɣar uɣezdis aḍeffar n tɣarrabut, izzeř din uca iṭṭeṣ ijj n yiḍeṣ yuǧeɣ.
Yusa-dd ɣares bab n tɣarrabut, inna as: “Min tᵉttegged, mayemmi dinni tᵉṭṭṣed? Kkar, řaɣa x AREBBI nnec, ad taɣ AREBBI nnec ad aneɣ ifekkar ḥima war nɣarreq ca.”
Nnan yeryazen i wayawya: “As-dd, ejj aneɣ ad nḍar taqedduḥt, ḥima ad nessen wi d aneɣ iggin di nnɛi-ya.” Nitni nḍaren taqedduḥt uca tusa-dd tqedduḥt deg Yunus.
Xenni nnan as: “Ini aneɣ, mayemmi d aneɣ teḥkem nnɛi-ya. Min teɛna řxedmet nnec? Manis dd-tusid? Min teɛna tammurt nnec u zi man řgens i ɣar teqqned?”
Inna asen: “Necc d Aɛibrani uca ggʷedeɣ zi SIDI, AREBBI n ijenwan, wenni dd-ixeřqen řebḥar d řbar.”
Iryazen nni ggʷeden aṭṭas, nnan as: “Min teggid?” Minzi tuɣa ssnen, netta yarweř-dd zeg wudem n SIDI, aqa tuɣa zeɛma issxebbar i-ten.
Uca nnan as: “Min zzayek i ɣa negg, ḥima ad xaneɣ ihedden řebḥar?” Minzi řebḥar tuɣa ɛad yarenni deg uhaji.
Inna asen: “Ksim ayi u nḍarem ayi di řebḥar ḥima ad xawem ihedden řebḥar, minzi ssneɣ aqa taḥaryaḍt-a tameqqrant i xawem dd-iwḍan di ssibbet inu.”
Maca iryazen tuɣa qeddfen ɣar řbar, maca war d as zemmaren ca, minzi řebḥar tuɣa ɛad yarenni xasen aṭṭas s waṭṭas deg uhaji.
Xenni řaɣan i SIDI, nnan: “A SIDI, war d aneɣ ttejji ca ad nettwahellek di ssibbet n řeɛmar n weryaz-a uca war d aneɣ tḥessibed x idammen imezdagen, minzi Cek, a SIDI, teggid min d ac yarḍan.”
Xas uca ṭṭfen Yunus, nḍaren t di řebḥar. Řexdenni ibedd uhaji n řebḥar.
Ggʷden iryazen nni aṭṭas zi SIDI uca ɣarṣen ict n tɣarṣt i SIDI uca waɛden lwuɛud.
